services.name: Carl Peters: Blacksmith Exhibit
services.desc: This special exhibition celebrates the life and work of Carl Peters, an immigrant blacksmith who lived and worked at Camulos from about 1920 to 1943. During his time at the rancho, Peters forged iron into useful tools, imaginative decorative works, and handcrafted pieces that served daily life. He left behind a legacy that continues to define the character of the property today. More than a craftsman, Carl Peters was an artist in iron. While blacksmithing is often associated with sturdy hinges, hardware, and agricultural tools, Peters brought something more to his forge.
